parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for a domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the custom frequency control rule that you want to delete.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo delete-web-cc-rule --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --name wq --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo DeleteWebCCRule --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId default --Domain 'www.aliyun.com' --Name wq
